title: Understanding the Model
text: The model given is: \( \hat{y}=2\theta_0+\theta_0**{4}\theta_1x-e**{2\theta_1}x**{2} \). This is a non-linear model with respect to \( $$\theta_0$$ \) and \( $$\theta_1$$ \).

title: Mean Squared Error (MSE)
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) is defined as \( L=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\hat{y_i})**2 \).

title: Gradient Vector
text: The gradient vector is the vector of partial derivatives of the loss function \( L \) with respect to the parameters \( $$\theta_0$$ \) and \( $$\theta_1$$ \).

title: Partial Derivative with respect to \( $$\theta_0$$ \)
text: Find the partial derivative of \( L \) with respect to \( $$\theta_0$$ \).

title: Partial Derivative with respect to \( $$\theta_1$$ \)
text: Find the partial derivative of \( L \) with respect to \( $$\theta_1$$ \).

title: Combine the Partial Derivatives
text: Combine the partial derivatives to form the gradient vector: \( \frac{\partial{L}}{\partial{\theta}}=(\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}2(y_i-2\theta_0-\theta_0**{4}\theta_1x_i+e**{2\theta_1}x_i**{2})(-2-4\theta_0**{3}\theta_1x_i),\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}2(y_i-2\theta_0-\theta_0**{4}\theta_1x_i+e**{2\theta_1}x_i**{2})(-\theta_0**{4}x_i+2e**{2\theta_1}x_i**{2})) \).
